q: She _____ to open the heavy door because her hands were full of grocery bags.
translation: 她费力地去开那扇沉重的门，因为她双手都提着购物袋。

q: After a long _____ with illness, he finally recovered and went back to his normal life.
translation: 经过与疾病的长期斗争，他终于康复了，回到了正常的生活。

q: Every _____ in the class must complete the project before the end of the semester.
translation: 班上每个学生都必须在学期结束前完成这个项目。

q: The artist spends most of her day painting alone in her small, quiet _____ downtown.
translation: 那位艺术家大部分时间都在市中心她那间小而安静的工作室里独自画画。

q: He _____ the map carefully before choosing the best route for the long hike.
translation: 他仔细研究了地图，然后为长途徒步选择了最佳路线。

q: A recent _____ shows that regular reading helps reduce stress in adults and teenagers alike.
translation: 最近的一项研究表明，定期阅读有助于减少成年人和青少年的压力。

q: There is too much _____ on my desk, and I cannot find my phone under all those papers.
translation: 我桌子上有太多东西了，在那堆文件下面找不到手机。

q: It would be a _____ mistake to drive in this weather without any winter tires on the car.
translation: 在这种天气下开车不装冬季轮胎，那将是愚蠢的错误。

q: The house was built in a modern _____ with large windows and clean, simple lines.
translation: 这栋房子以现代风格建造，有大窗户和简洁利落的线条。

q: My favorite _____ in high school was history, especially learning about ancient civilizations and empires.
translation: 我高中最喜欢的科目是历史，尤其是学习古代文明和帝国。

q: Art criticism is highly _____ and depends a lot on personal taste and individual experience.
translation: 艺术评论是高度主观的，很大程度上取决于个人品味和个体经验。

q: She _____ her application for the scholarship just a few hours before the final deadline.
translation: 她在最终截止时间前几个小时提交了奖学金申请。

q: I _____ to a weekly magazine that covers new technology and science news from around the world.
translation: 我订阅了一本周刊，内容涵盖来自世界各地的新科技和科学新闻。

q: The first test was easy, but all the _____ exams were far more challenging and required deeper understanding.
translation: 第一次考试很简单，但所有随后的考试都难得多，需要更深的理解。

q: A strange sticky _____ was leaking from the container onto the floor of the warehouse.
translation: 一种奇怪的黏稠物质从容器中泄漏到仓库的地板上。

q: The company made a _____ profit in the last quarter, which surprised many financial analysts.
translation: 公司上个季度获得了可观的利润，这让许多金融分析师感到惊讶。

q: They moved from the city center to a quiet _____ with more space and better schools.
translation: 他们从市中心搬到了一个安静的郊区，那里有更多的空间和更好的学校。

q: I take the _____ to work every day because it's faster than driving through all the traffic.
translation: 我每天坐地铁上班，因为比开车穿过拥堵的交通更快。

q: After many years of hard work, she finally _____ in starting her own successful business.
translation: 经过多年的努力，她终于成功创办了自己的企业。

q: The event was a huge _____ and attracted more visitors than the organizers had ever expected.
translation: 活动取得了巨大的成功，吸引的参观者比主办方预期的还要多。

q: She is one of the most _____ businesswomen in the country and inspires many young entrepreneurs.
translation: 她是全国最成功的女企业家之一，激励着许多年轻的创业者。

q: The car made a _____ stop to avoid hitting a dog that ran onto the road.
translation: 汽车突然停下，以免撞到跑到路上的狗。

q: The family _____ a great deal during the long and bitterly cold winter without enough heating.
translation: 在漫长而严寒的冬天里，那家人因为供暖不足而遭受了很多苦难。

translation: 确保你有足够的时间完成考试，不必匆匆忙忙地赶最后几道题。

q: I usually put two spoons of _____ in my coffee, but today I decided to skip it.
translation: 我通常在咖啡里放两勺糖，但今天决定不放了。

q: My friend _____ a nice restaurant where we could all meet for dinner on Friday evening.
translation: 我的朋友推荐了一家不错的餐厅，我们周五晚上可以在那里聚餐。

q: Do you have any helpful _____ for how we might improve the service in our café?
translation: 你有没有什么好的建议能让我们改善咖啡馆的服务？

q: He wore a dark blue _____ and a matching tie to the job interview downtown.
translation: 他穿了一套深蓝色西装和一条搭配的领带去市中心参加面试。

q: The quiet and peaceful countryside life really _____ her after years of living in a noisy city.
translation: 在喧闹的城市生活多年后，宁静的乡村生活真的非常适合她。

q: This movie is not _____ for very young children because some scenes are too frightening for them.
translation: 这部电影不适合年幼的孩子，因为有些场景对他们来说太吓人了。

q: He paid a large _____ of money for the rare painting at the auction last spring.
translation: 去年春天他在拍卖会上花了一大笔钱买下了那幅罕见的画作。

q: At the end of the chapter, there is a short _____ of all the main points and ideas.
translation: 章节末尾有一个简短的摘要，总结了所有要点和想法。

q: We plan to spend part of our _____ vacation at a small cottage by the sea this year.
translation: 今年我们计划在海边的一间小屋里度过部分暑假。

q: The room gets a lot of natural light because the _____ shines directly through the big window.
translation: 这个房间自然光充足，因为太阳直接从大窗户照进来。

q: We decided to go to the beach because it was a bright and _____ afternoon in July.
translation: 我们决定去海滩，因为那是七月里一个明亮晴朗的下午。

q: The food at the new restaurant downtown is absolutely _____, and the service is equally excellent.
translation: 市中心那家新餐厅的食物绝对超级棒，服务也同样出色。

q: The singer gave a _____ performance that brought the entire audience to its feet at the end.
translation: 那位歌手进行了一场精彩绝伦的演出，结束时全场观众都起立鼓掌。

q: This particular model offers _____ sound quality compared to the other, less expensive, brands available.
translation: 与其他那些更便宜的品牌相比，这款型号提供了更优越的音质。

q: I stopped at the _____ on my way home to buy some fresh vegetables and a loaf of bread.
translation: 我在回家的路上去了超市，买了些新鲜蔬菜和一条面包。

q: The local farms _____ most of the fresh fruit and vegetables for the school cafeteria program.
translation: 当地农场为学校食堂项目供应了大部分的新鲜水果和蔬菜。

q: The heavy storm cut off the town's water _____ for nearly three full days last winter.
translation: 去年冬天，猛烈的暴风雨切断了该镇的供水将近整整三天。

q: His parents always _____ his decision to become an artist, even when money was very tight.
translation: 他的父母一直支持他成为艺术家的决定，即使在手头很紧的时候。

q: The team received tremendous _____ from their fans throughout the entire long and difficult season.
translation: 整个漫长而艰难的赛季中，球队得到了球迷们巨大的支持。

q: You are _____ to turn off all electronic devices before the plane takes off from the runway.
translation: 你应该在飞机从跑道起飞前关闭所有电子设备。

q: I am not entirely _____ that this is the right street, so let's check the map again.
translation: 我不太确定这是不是那条正确的街道，我们再看看地图吧。

q: We _____ the internet for hours looking for the best deals on flights to the coast.
translation: 我们上网搜了好几个小时，寻找去海边最划算的机票。

q: The _____ of the water was so smooth and calm that it reflected the mountains like a mirror.
translation: 水面如此平滑宁静，像镜子一样倒映着群山。

q: The _____ explained the details of the procedure to the patient and her family before the operation.
translation: 外科医生在手术前向病人及其家属解释了手术的细节。

q: He had to undergo emergency _____ on his knee after the skiing accident in the mountains.
translation: 他在山上滑雪出事后，不得不接受膝盖紧急手术。

q: The party was a complete _____ for her, and she almost started crying when she saw everyone.
translation: 派对对她来说完全是个惊喜，她看到大家时几乎哭了出来。

translation: 检查结果让医生们感到惊讶，他们原本预期病人的康复会慢得多。

q: The small village is _____ by high mountains on all sides, making it feel very remote.
translation: 小村庄被四面高山环绕，显得非常偏远。

translation: 城堡和周围的乡村每年夏天吸引成千上万的游客。

translation: 根据最近的一项调查，该市大多数人支持新的公共交通计划。

q: The team carefully _____ the damage to the building before starting any repair work on it.
translation: 团队在开始修复工作前，仔细勘察了建筑的损坏情况。

translation: 奇迹般地，所有乘客都在飞机失事中幸存下来，被发现时正在残骸附近等待。

translation: 警方立刻怀疑了那个人，因为他每次讲述时说法都在变。

translation: 主要嫌疑人被看到在警报大声响起前几分钟离开了大楼。

translation: 由于恶劣且不可预测的天气状况，航空公司暂停了所有飞往该地区的航班。

q: The athlete _____ a minor injury during the match but continued to play until the final whistle.

translation: 一阵强风扫过开阔的田野，把高高的草几乎吹弯到了地面。

translation: 蛋糕对我来说有点太甜了，但孩子们非常喜欢，每一口都吃得很开心。

translation: 我对那些并非自身过错而失业的人深表同情。
